༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje grags pa'i zhal gzigs pa'i lugs su grags pa ma mo srog gzer gyi sgrub thabs klag chog bzhugs/ya mān ta ka'i las byed snyan ra

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje grags pa'i zhal gzigs pa'i lugs su

grags pa ma mo srog gzer gyi sgrub thabs klag chog bzhugs/ ya mān ta ka'i las byed snyan rgyud shin tu gsang ba/ na mo gu ru/ dpal he ru kas byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal ldan nag mo re ma ti/ nyams pa'i srog rtsa dmar po gzir ba/ zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs las byung ba'i man ngag la/ gzhung nas mi gsal ba'i man ngag lag len kha 'gengs dgos rnams/ mkha' 'gro chen mo'i lugs ltar byed pa dang*/ nyi ma smod rgyud kyi lugs bzhin byed pa'i srol gnyis ka yod/ dang po ni/ mkha' 'gro chen mo'i sgrub thabs su bshad zin pa ltar la 'dod pa spos pas khyab/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i bdag bskyed sngon du btang*/ mchod gtor bshams/ bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ baṃ las rakta'i rgya mtsho'i mtha' brag ris bskor ba/ dbus su rdo rje'i sa gzhi la bhruṃ las thod pa 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'jigs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ / bhruṃ bi shwa bi shuddhai ka pa la bhruṃ/ de'i dbus su e las smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /gnyis pa hūṃ de'i dbus su srin po'i bong bu ka dmar rlung gi gshog pa can/ mjug ma'i phyogs su mig yod pa/ zhing chen gyi ling ga dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i steng du bhyoḥyig nag po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ 'khor 'das kyi nus mthu thams cad tshur bsdus te bhyoḥyig la thim/ oṃ de bī mahā kā li hūṃ/ de las dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī sku mdog mthing nag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra sgrog pa/

ral pa mun pa ltar gtibs pa/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris can re ldai'i sham bu dang*/ zhing lpags dang glang lpags sbyar ba'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ sbrul gyi rgyan can/ dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa/ lte ba nas nyi ma dang*/ spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ srin po'i bong bu gwa dmar la chibs shing*/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na gnas pa'o/ / 'khor bdud mo nag mo 'bum sde thams cad kyang gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar yang yi ge bhyo yig go /thugs kha'i bhyoḥlas bhyoḥyig mang po spros te bdud mo 'bum sder gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ srog bdag chen mo badzra sa mā dzaḥ nag mo ting laṃ ma ma dun bhyoḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ nag mo dun bhyoḥdun bhyoḥ zhes spyan drangs shing*/ gnyis su med par thim/ nag mo rag mo dun ting ma ma na maḥ.a a hi/ zhes pas phyag 'tshal/ trag rag sha ma hi ku la padma sa ma ya tiṣta lhan/ bzhugs su gsol/ bhyo/ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo re ma ti/ lha mo chen po nam gru ma/ /rdzong mo chen mo dka' bzlog ma/ / nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ /byis pa kun gyi dung byed ma/ /dur khraud 'bar ba'i lo ma can/ /rakṣa chen mo tsa munṭa/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mthu mo che/ /bar snang khams kyi glog ma sprin/ kha nas me 'bar rgya mtsho skems/ /lag na rdo rje ri rab bsnyil/ /ral pa nag po stong khams khyab/ /zhal nas khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ / nyin gyi dus su grogs byed ma/ /mtshan gyi dus su rgyug byed ma/ /nag mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ /sha chen tshogs ni ri ltar spungs/ /tsitta tshogs ni rdza ltar lhag /rakta rgya mtsho rba klong 'khyil/ /'khor bcas thugs dam bskong gyur cing*/ /nag mo kha la dza ya du sa ma ya ho/ ru lu ru lu dun bhyoḥ snying kha la ma hi dun bhyoḥ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ ma mo nag mo santi santa ku lu ku lu ha ha ha/

mahā maṃ sa kha hi/ mahā rakta kha hī/ mahā pañtsa amṛ ta kha hī/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang gi mdun du ma mo nye bar spyan drangs/ thugs kar bhyoḥyig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab/ mchod cing thugs rgyud bskul bar bsam la/ oṃ mahā kā la re ma ti ma ma ru lu rakṣa re ma ti/ ru lu ru lu bhyoḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa'i sngags so/ / oṃ ru ru tsa tur a shug me pra ti ru dra kha shag rag mo hūṃ/ rakṣa tsitta sa ma ya/ ku ru kha tsitta nan/ zhes pa 'di bsgrub pa'i skabs kyi bod pa'o/ / oṃ ru ru bo ti hūṃ/ tiṣṭha ba to si rakmo snying kha la raka mo thun mo thun bhyoḥdza dzaḥ rbad pa'o/ / oṃ ṣu lu re ma ti sa ma ya pra ma ha sti pra ma ma rag mo ru lu ru lu bhyoḥdza dza/ kha raka dri khim dza dza/ kha le thun bhyoḥthun ma ma bhyoḥ thun brdeg pa'i sngags so/ / hūṃ ka mo rni sha ku ru thun rbad/ raka mo arya dza dza dri khebs kha le bhyoḥbhyoḥdza dza/ sa mā ya dgra bo'i mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bsad pa'i sngags so/ /mthar 'bru gsum gyi gtor ma byin rlabs kha gsos la/ dgra bgegs thams cad bkugs cing bstim par mos te/ bsnyen sngags kyi mthar/ e dam ba ling ta kha kha kha hī kha hī/ bhuñdza ho rakta si ba sa ma ya swāhā/ lan bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bhyoḥ rgya mtsho'i klong na me 'bar khyod/ /mtsho rnams skems par nus ma ste/ /bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir/ /lha chen sku'i phyed du bzhugs/ /rdzong dang dka' bzlog nag mo che/ /lha dang lha min phyag byas ma/ / mi nad gang yin khyod kyi shes/ /de la 'jigs pa med par 'gyur/ /gshin rje lcam mo bdud kyi yum/ /nad do cog gi bdag mo ste/ /'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ khyod la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes pa nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / gi bar gyis 'phrin las bcol/

yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha skong zhing bzod par gsol lo/ /rten yod na brtan zhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol bya/ 'di ni gtor chog tsam yin la/ lha mo'i bskang ba ni/ re ma tī spyi dang mthun pas chog gi /'di la yig rnying rgyas pa logs su med/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i brnyen pa byed na/ gnas dben par bris sku'i mdun du gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sman dang*/ rakta rnams bshams/ yang na rdo leb lta bu'i steng du gri khrag dang mtshal thig bsres pa'i gru gsum chom bu dang bcas pa bris/ sku'i tshab tu byas na'ang legs/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ bgegs gtor rgya chen btang*/ mtshams bcad bsrung 'khor bsgom/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ sman raka gtor ma rnams yi dam gyi lugs su byin gyis brlabs/ yi dam gyi mdun bskyed yod na mchod gtor 'bul ba yan chad bya/ yi dam gyi mdun bskyed med kyang chog /de nas lha mo nyid kyi rim pa ni gong du bshad pa bzhin yin pa la/ bzlas pa'i skabs su slebs pa na dang por bsnyen sngags de nyid 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzla/ de bar du gzhan rnams tshar gsum tsam re sbyor ba ma gtogs bzlas pa byed mi dgos/ de song nas bsnyen sngags cung zad re sngon du btang*/ bod pa khri phrag bzhi bzlas te/ de song nas gnyis po de cung zad re bzlas pa'i rjes su rbad pa bzhi khri'o/ /de rjes gsum po de cung zad bzlas nas thun sngags bzhi khri'o/ de nas sngags lnga tshar gcig tu dril nas khri phrag gcig bzlas par byed de/ 'on kyang bzhi khri bzlas nas bzang ngo*/ /bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir bskang ba dang bshags pa yang yang bya/ de tsam gyi rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa grub pa yin no/ / 'di ni mdor bsdus pa'i lugs yin pas/ sgrub pa dang las sbyaur gcig tu dril/ rbad pa dang bsad pa yang gcig tu dril ba yin pas so sor mi dgos so/

/'di la dang por dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ gsung rab sgrog pa dang*/ tsha tsha gdab pa dang*/ smon lam khyad par can 'debs pa dang*/ bgegs gtor gtong ba dang*/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma gtong*/ sde brgyad spyi la'ang mchod gtor bden bdar dang bcas pa 'brub khung bskyed de bya/ /mtshams bcad/ bsrung 'khor bsgom/ rdzas rnams tshogs par bya/ yi dam dang chos skyong gi bsnyen pa kha gso/ de nas grog mkhar bdun gyis sa la stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i dbus su/ 'brub khung gru gsum kha khyer can cig bya/ kha la dug khrag gi byugs pa'i rtsar nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ phur bu nyi shu rtsa gcig srin mo 'gros su btsugs/ gru gsum gyi 'debs rang la bstan/ rtse mo'i phyogs su thang ka'am/ tsa ka li mda' dar la btags pa bzhugs/ stegs bu'i lho nub kyi zur la brten gtor/ dbus su sngags kyi shog dril btsugs pa gri rgod kyi shas brgyan pa/ nal bu'i snying ma nyams pa mda' thung la brtag pa gcig kyang btsug /byang shar gyi zur la thun khang bya ste/ der 'ug pa'i sgro ngar mi rims khrag dang*/ dug khrag blug /shar lhor gri thod du gri khrag dang*/ khrag sna tshogs blug /nub byang du mdze khrag dang*/ ram bu dang*/ dug gis bkang ba'i phag thod bzhag /yungs kar yungs nag sogs skam thun rnams thod ngan du blugs te phyogs ji ltar 'os par bzhag /chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar bsad sngags ming dang bcas pa 'bri/ zur drug la yan lag drug 'og tu mnan pa'i tshul du bri/ phyi'i mu khyud la rbad sngags dang thun sngags kyis bskor ba 'bri/ rten gtor gyi 'og tu mnan/ tshil chen byug pa'i shog bu la ling ga 'bri tshul spyi dang 'dra ba las/ snying khar che ge mo a karṣa ya dza/ bhandha bhandha ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa 'bri/ de'i mtha' bsad sngags mgo bo phyir bstan gyis bskor/ de'i phyi nas thun sngags kyis bskor/ de'i phyi nas bsnyen sngags dang 'bod rbad kyis bskor/

thams cad la 'di zhes bya ba mā ra ya sod bhyoḥbhyoḥya ya chum chum/ zhes pas mtha' brten de la rdzas bcug /dgug gzhug mang du byas te mgo nas mar bsgril nas/ shi skras bcings te bag zan btsos pa la rdzas bsres pa'i nya bo'i lte bar bcug /de 'brub khung gi dbus su bzhag ste/ mi shi ba'i skra'i srad bu yan lag lnga nas bcings/ de'i snod de skyer phur la bcings nas/ rten gtor gyi mdun du phur bu la btod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dam rdzas nal bu'i sha khrag bsres pa'i rgyu bzang po'i gtor ma brjid ldan gcig g.yas phyogs su bshams/ de ka 'dra ba zhig g.yon phyogs su thag cung zad ring bar gta' gtor gyi tshul du byed/ de dar nag gis g.yog pa'i sgrom du bcug kyang rung*/ gzhan yang sha khrag dmar gyi brgyan pa'i gtor ma spyi gtor gyi tshul du gang bder bsgrig /gong du bshad pa'i bris ling de kha 'dra ba gcig byas la/ ling ga chen po'i 'og tu 'ding ba'am/ 'brub khung gi nang log la mgo gzhug ldog ste bkram yang rung*/ gzhon nu ma gtsang ma'i lag pa'i srin lag la g.yab dar nag po btab pa dang*/ mnan pa dang sbyin sreg gi yo byad rnams kyang tshang bar bya/ las la 'jug pa'i sngon du/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ bgegs bskrad/ mtshams bcad/ mtho gzug /bsrung 'khor sgom pa rnams nyi ma dang po la bya/ zhag phyi ma rnams la gnas yo byin rlabs nges par bya/ sngon 'gro gtor ma 'grub na legs/ de nas thun dang po la yi dam gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du btang*/ las sbyor gyi skabs 'dir yi dam gyi mdun bskyed mchod gtor yang gal che bas dus skabs 'dir byed/ slar yang mchod pa rnams rgyas par byin gyis rlabs/ sman phud rakta byin gyis rlabs pa nan tan gyi bskyed/ de rjes mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs sogs gong bzhin byas nas bskang ba la thug gi bar du'o/

/ de nas rang nyid yi dam gnas gyur pa'i dpal lha mo nag mor bsgom/ snying po lan 'ga' zur zung brjod/ bar der ling ga bskyed cing*/ dgug gzhug lan mang du bya/ snying po dang 'bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel ba'i mthar/ chgai mo'i bla srog thams cad a karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥzhes btags pa brgya tsam re bzlas nas/ de nas sngags lnga char sbrel ba kho na bzla/ bzlas pa po lha dang phral ba dang*/ dgug gzhug bcing ba dang*/ ldag tshad bcag pa'i dmigs pa drag tu bya/ thun rnams la yang gzung thag btags te sngags lnga char gcig tu dril ba de ka thun re bzhin brgya phrag sogs bzlas pa des chog /thun sngags logs pa mi dgos/ thun re re bzhin gtor ma kha gsos te 'bul/ gta' gtor de 'grub na thun de bzhin dang*/ de tsam ma grub na thun tha ma la kha gsos shing byin rlabs byed tshul spyi dang 'dra/ thun mtshams su 'brub khung ro ras sam g.yam pas kha bcad/ de ltar zhag bdun tshun chad la khugs pa'i rtags 'byung*/ ling ga la sgra tshag tshag thag thog byung na rtags yin/ lar 'di rbad bsad gcig tu dril ba yin pas/ khug pa'i rtags la dgug sdod rang yang mi dgos/ zhag bdun song nas rtags ma byung rung*/ bsad las la zhugs pas mchog / de yang bya ba'i rim pa rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ bzlas pa'i sngon gyi dgug gzhug tshar gsum byas nas/ dgug pa'i sngags cung zad tsam bzla/ mang du bzlas mi dgos/ de rjes bzlas pa dngos sngags brgya brgya tsam song mtshams su thun brdeg pa'i srol yod/ 'on kyang 'di ltar legs pa 'phreng rdog drug cu pa gcig la sngags lnga po sbrel nas bgrangs te 'phreng skor re re'i mtha' ma/ gnyis gnyis kyi mtha' ma/ gsum gsum gyi mthar thug sngags bsad sngags sbrel ba kho na tshar dgu dgu ling ga la thun rdeg go /ling ga'i snying gar ro skras gzungs thag btags/ bzlas pa byed pa'i tshe de'i sne nas bzung*/ bzlas pa 'jog tsa na rdo rje la btag ste/

de'i snying gar mnan no/ /bzlas pa dkyus kyi dmigs pa'i skabs/ rang dang mdun gyi lha mo gnyis kar gyi phyag g.yon par lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pas bcings shing 'then 'then 'dren par bsams/ rlung phyir 'phros pa'i bdag mdun gnyis ka'i sa bon sngags phreng la mkha' 'gro ma shin tu khros pa/ gri thod 'dzin pa mang po spros nas/ mdun gyi bsgrub bya'i snying ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi khog nang du song nas gnad thams cad gri gug gis bcad/ khyad par srog rtsa bcad cing rtsa ba nas bton/ snying ga nas rnam shes mar me ltar 'bar ba de/ phyag g.yon pa'i thod pas dug khrag blug te/ thum thum bsad par bsam/ bsgrub bya'i tshe srog lus kyi dwangs bcud rnams bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin hūṃ du gyur pa ste/ mkha' 'gro ma de rnams kyis tshur blangs nas/ rlung nang du yong ba dang bstun bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi sna sgo nas zhugs te/ snying ga'i sa bon sngags phreng la thim pas bkrag mdangs bcud du gyur nas/ bsgrub bya'i tshe dang dbang thang thams cad rang nyid la byung zhing rgya cher 'phel bar bsam/ dmigs pa'i grangs la spyir ngos bzung dang mi dgos kyang*/ sngags sbrags ma lan drug drug la de dmigs pa de tshar re

bsgoms nas mtshams par 'ong bas lag len la de ltar bya zhes bla mas gsung*/ de 'dra lan dgu song nas tha ma'i sngags lan drug la 'gog bzlas bya ste/ rlung 'bud pa'i tshe bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi shangs kyi sgo nas 'thor rlung drag po mi bzad pa spros te/ bsgrub bya'i rnam shes mar me lta bu ni bsad/ lus thams cad shag shig tu btang bar bsam/ rlung nang du yong tsa na kho'i rtsa rlung thig le'i dwangs ma dang*/ bsrung ba/ nus pa/ dge legs/ tshe srog bsod nams dbang thang thams cad thig le dkar po'i rnam par drangs te/ rang dang mdun bskyed kyi shangs kyi sgo nas zhugs te/ thugs ka'am lte bar thim pas mdangs dang bde ba rgyas par bsam/ de nas thun gyi skabs thog mar skam thun mtshon cha'i char du 'bebs/ srin mo mi bzad pa mang pos bcom par yang bsam/ de nas rlon thun dang po dug gi char pa dang*/ gnyis pa'i nad kyi char phabs pas mtsho 'khyil te gzhi gcig tu dum bur bsam/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro ma mang po sprul nas bcom par bsam/ tshul de lha bu'i bsad las brtsams/ mthun phyi ma rnams la rang nyid yi dam gyi ngo bo ma mor sgom pa de kas chog /yang phar phyag 'tshal ba'i rmi lam byung na yi dam gyi bdag bskyed dang bzlas pa mang tsam bya/ sngags dag por bzla ba dang*/ bar bar du bskang bshags gal che/ gzas pa po bsad pa dang*/ bshas byed pa dang*/ nang khrol sogs sha zos pa dang*/ dngos su rang nyid skyug mer ba song*/ 'jom par byung na bsad pa'i rtags yin te/ de yang gzhung las/ thun las me stag 'phro na zor 'phen par bshad/ de lar ma byung na sbyin sreg dang mnan tsam zhig byed pa 'dra ba zhig byung na'ang*/ da lta lag len du 'debs rgyu la 'phang bsregs mnan gsum gar bya ste/ bsad rtags lan gcig tsam la ma bzhag par/ da dung yun bsrings te bsgrubs pas rang bsad rtags lan gnyis gsum du byung na nges can yin pas/ thun rtags byung rung ma byung rung myur bul dang stobs che chung gis khyad tsam las 'grub par ni nges/

'bru nag gi phye la dug khrag bsres pa la zor gtor gcig bcos dug khrag gis byug /bra bo sran nag ske tshe sogs blug /zhag gcig gnyis gsum tshun chod du thun gzhan rnams dang lhan cig dmigs pa gtad de bsgrubs/ rlon thun gsum dang*/ skam thun gyi snod du lhag ma cung zad re bzhag /gzhan rnams thod ngan nam lcags snod du blug /ling ga la sngar btab zin pa 'brub khung na yod pa'i de nas kyang cung zad blug /drag sngags bzla zhing thun rnams gcig tu bsres/ rang nyid drag po'i chas su zhugs/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis yi dam du bskyed nas sngags drag tu bzla/ ma mo drag tu bskul/ de nas rang nyid lha mo'i skur bsgyur ba'i nga rgyal gyis dgra yul mthong ba'am/ de min na'ang ri rtse sogs dmigs pa gsal sa gcig tu song nas/ bden bdar dang dmod bcol drag tu byas pa'i mthar/ sngags lnga sbrel lan bdun bzlas pa'i mjug la gtor ma 'phangs/ thun sngags bsad sngags sbrel ba 'ba' zhig bzla bzhin du thun rnams cha shas cha shas nas zad zad du 'phang*/ mi lpags sam/ ro shun gyi dol mo ka gdab bo/ / de nas nang du 'ong nas 'brub khung gi ling ga bsgral te gtor ma la cung zad btab/ ling ro gzhan nal bu'i sha khrag dang*/ gzhan yang drag rdzas spyi dang mthun pas bsreg rdzas rnams dang*/ sngar gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gtor ma dang bcas pa/ ling ga'i mthu'i thun ro thams cad kyang blangs sbyin sreg bya/ dpal lha mo nyid me lha yin pas me lha 'jig rten pa'i cho ga dgos/ sngags lnga sbrel gyi mthar agne ye kro dha dzwa la raṃ raṃ/ che ge mo/ ma ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa ni bsregs rdzas 'bul ba'i sngags so/ /'dir ling ga gser ba gcig kyang bsgral nas 'bul/ sngags ni drug cu la sogs pa'i ji ltar 'os pa'o/ /de nas 'brub khung nang gi bris ling de dang*/ gtor gdan gyi bris ling de gnyis kha sbyar/ mgo nas dril te g.yag rgod kyi rwa nang du bcug

/dug rigs brdungs pa'i phye ma dang*/ sbyin sreg gi thal ba tshom bu tsam zhig rnams bcugs te/ lam rgya 'gram mam/ klu gnyan gnas sa'am/ dur khrod dam/ mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan par bya'o/ /sngar gyi btab gtor de thob thang la phyi rtags byung na 'bul ba yin kyang*/ de tsam 'jog mi thub na/ skabs 'dir 'bul lo/ / yang bsad rtags nang rtags byung na 'bul ba gcig kyang yod de/ de la ni rtags gtor zhes bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang dga' ston bya zhing*/ nam smad bskang bshags dang dngos grub blang ba nan tan tu bskyed/ gtor ma gsar ba dang*/ thun gtor yang bshams shing bsngos nas/ skya rengs dang po shar ba na khang steng dar 'phyar/ rol mo brdungs/ gtor ma gsar ba de dag dang*/ sngar gyi thun mong gi gtor ma de spyi btab kyi tshul gyis btang*/ 'phrin las bcol/ smon lam btab/ bkra shis brjod do/ /de nas sgrub khang du rjes chog dang nyer bsdu byas te spyir dang mthun no/ /sgrub thabs 'di ni mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug tu lo tsā ba rdo grags pa nyid kyis zhal gzigs pa'i dpal lha mo'i sgrub thabs gsar ma de yin/ 'di la thun drug la sogs pa'i rnam grangs mang po de mi dgos par gcig la 'dus pas lag len shin tu 'khyer bde ba yin no/ / spyir lha mo nyid chos skyong gi mthil du byed na mdos chog gal che ba yin par 'dug /ma mo spyi'i mdos chog dang*/ lha mo'i spyi bskang gi cho ga rgyas pa ni yi ge rnying pa gzhan du blta bar bya yi/ 'dir bris pas mang ba yin no/ /zhes pa 'di yang rwa'i rigs su skyes shing*/ 'jam dpal rdo rje grags pa'i bka' brgyud cung zad 'dzin pa/ rgyal khams tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas gzhung gi gsal byed du man ngag lag len klag chog gi tshul du bris pa'o// // maṅga maṃ/ dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/
